name: Stage 53:1: Sandviks badplats to Källviks brygga
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 53:1, Sandviks badplats to Källviks brygga.
utilities: Official area: Nyköpings kommun, Trosa kommun.

Sandviks badplats is the start-side service node with seasonal tap, toilet, fireplaces, parking, and the stage-52/53/53:1 junction; Sandviks camping is a separate paid service node west of the badplats.

Källviks brygga is an access/boat endpoint for Sävö rather than a full service node. Parking and boat access are verified, but no reliable public mainland water or confirmed current public toilet was found at the brygga itself; summer parking can fill and overflow must not block residents, road traffic, or emergency access.

Public transport is awkward: no regular Sandvik/Källvik bus stop was verified. Treat Källviks brygga as car, pickup, complementary taxi, booked boat, or out-and-back logistics unless live Sörmlandstrafiken planning says otherwise.
Sävö services are useful only after a boat transfer. Sävö has island toilets, a water tap by Sävö gård/naturskola, and seasonal hostel/cafe context, but those are not mainland Stage 53:1 services.
waterSources: No reliable potable water was verified on the mainland Stage 53:1 after the Sandviks badplats service cluster.
Use Sandviks badplats/camping water only as seasonal/current-check service water; the Sandviks tap sits about 300 m west of the official 53:1 start pin.

Källviks brygga should not be shown as a drinking-water point unless field-verified. Sävö has water at Sävö gård by the naturskola/gate area and seasonal hostel/cafe services, but only after a boat transfer and when open/booked.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Sörmlandsleden distance is 8 km; Naturkartan lists 6.9 km/6,896 m and its API geometry measured about 6.876 km, while OSM relation 8426186 measured about 6.866 km. Keep 8 km as the official planning distance and use the OSM relation geometry as the current map line.

The previous official-network GPX extraction for this app ended near Långmaren/Klacka instead of Källviks brygga. Use the OSM relation geometry for 53:1 until the official full-network GPX is corrected.

The first kilometres follow Tvären, a bay linked in official text to a meteorite impact about 450 million years ago. The route then passes Mättinge/Luckebol/Folkvik context, includes roughly 2 km of country-road walking plus a final Källvik road/service approach, and finishes through younger forest/deciduous woodland to Källviks brygga.

User reports describe the Sandvik/Tvären side as the best part, with mostly easy coastal/mixed walking, managed forest, powerline/open corridors, road walking, and a sometimes uneven, brushier, less-used final forest approach toward Källvik. No current official 53:1 fault report was found.
Mättinge/Valjeviken may offer booked lodging or transfer help near the branch, but exact map placement and current offer should be verified before relying on it.

Luckebol nature reserve is side context south of the road corridor; it is not a trail service node, current Länsstyrelsen material says there is no parking there, and its visitor information warns of many bark-beetle-felled/fallen spruces with difficult passage and wind risk.

Boat logistics are safety-critical: Sörmlandstrafiken skärgårdstrafik must be prebooked by 15:30 the day before and may depend on weather/skipper; Sävö Vandrarhem/Café runs prebooked April-October transfers from Källviks brygga, usually 10:30 and 16:00, return 11:00 and 16:30, with extra July-August weekend departures and limited capacity.

Route-builder topology: do not auto-chain Stage 53:1 into Stage 53:2 as a walking route. The mainland line stops at Källviks brygga and the nearest Sävö/53:2 point is roughly 0.55 km away over water, so any continuation must be an explicit boat/transfer edge.

facilities.name: Sandviks badplats 53:1 branch start
facilities.description: Official start for the access branch to Källviks brygga, just east of the main Sandviks badplats service cluster. Stages 52 and 53 connect nearby in the same Sandvik start area.

facilities.name: Sandviks badplats seasonal tap
facilities.description: Seasonal/current-check water at Sandviks badplats near the branch start.

facilities.name: Sandviks badplats toilet
facilities.description: Mapped toilet at Sandviks badplats. Verify season/current condition.

facilities.name: Sandviks badplats fireplace
facilities.description: Mapped firepit at the badplats. Fire use is governed by Nynäs reserve rules and current fire bans.

facilities.name: Sandviks east beach fireplace
facilities.description: Additional mapped beach firepit near the 53:1 start and close to the official Mättinge-Sandvik rest/grill context. Use only under current reserve fire rules.

facilities.name: Sandviks camping
facilities.description: Paid camping west of Sandviks badplats with toilets, showers, power, and drinking-water service reported in OSM/camping directories. Nynäs treats this as the practical legal mainland overnight option; verify season/payment/current rules.

facilities.name: Sandviks camping recycling
facilities.description: Mapped recycling/waste point by Sandviks camping. Treat as camping/service-area context, not guaranteed public trash service.

facilities.name: Tvären shore shelter and toilet side context
facilities.description: Shelter/rest and nearby toilet context just west of Sandvik/camping, more relevant before/after the branch than on the 53:1 line itself. Verify current status on site.

facilities.name: Tvären meteorite-impact bay context
facilities.description: Official route text describes the early shoreline along Tvären, a sea bay formed by a meteorite impact about 450 million years ago. Approximate context marker.

facilities.name: Mättinge-Sandvik grill/rest
facilities.description: Official stage steward tip describes a good waterside grill/rest place with benches between Mättinge and Sandviks badplats; user reports corroborate the rest/grill context. Approximate pin only.

facilities.name: Valjeviken Mättinge lodging/transfer context
facilities.description: Nearby booked lodging/transfer context by the 53:1 corridor. Exact service details and pickup/boat-transfer options should be verified directly before relying on them.

facilities.name: Mättinge / Mättingeviken route landmark
facilities.description: Route landmark around the transition from shoreline/forest toward more road and open-land walking. Approximate context marker.

facilities.name: Luckebol route landmark
facilities.description: Official stage text says the route passes Luckebol before the road-walk section. Context marker, not a public service.

facilities.name: Luckebol reserve side context
facilities.description: Side-area reserve context near the road corridor. Not a trail facility; current Länsstyrelsen information says there is no parking at Luckebol and warns that many bark-beetle-damaged spruces have fallen, making passage difficult and windy conditions risky.

facilities.name: Folkvik route landmark
facilities.description: Official stage text says the route passes Folkvik after road walking. Föreningsgården Folkvik has local-history/WC-by-arrangement context but should not be treated as a public trail toilet.

facilities.name: Källviksvägen road-walk section
facilities.description: Official text describes about 2 km of country-road walking around Luckebol/Folkvik before the route returns to easier forest. Watch traffic and road shoulders.

facilities.name: Final young-forest approach to Källvik
facilities.description: Official text describes the last kilometres as easy walking through younger forest and deciduous woodland toward Källviks brygga. User reports mention managed forest/powerline context and possible side-growth near Källvik. Approximate context marker.

facilities.name: Källviks brygga stage end
facilities.description: Stage 53:1 mainland endpoint at Källviks brygga and access point for boat logistics to Sävö. Do not draw a walking continuation across the water; Stage 53:2 is across a roughly 0.55 km boat gap.

facilities.name: Källviks brygga boat access to Sävö
facilities.description: Boat access to Sävö and stage 53:2. Prebook Sävö Vandrarhem boat, Sävö gård transport, or Sörmlandstrafiken skärgårdstrafik; do not assume a chance lift, drop-in service, or guaranteed walk-on ferry.

facilities.name: Källviks brygga parking
facilities.description: Parking near the harbour/brygga; Sävö sources describe free parking but no EV charging. Parking can fill on busy summer days; overflow parking must not block roads, residents, docks, or emergency access.

facilities.name: Källviks brygga water/toilet caveat
facilities.description: No reliable public mainland drinking-water tap was verified at Källviks brygga, and only older/uncertain toilet information was found. Treat as no dependable mainland water and field-check any toilet before relying on it.

facilities.name: Sävö prebooked boat transfer
facilities.description: Sävö Vandrarhem/Café runs April-October prebooked boat transfers from Källviks brygga: usually 10:30 and 16:00 from mainland, 11:00 and 16:30 return, with extra 12:30/13:00 weekend departures in July-August. Crossing is about 10 minutes, capacity is limited, and booking is required.

facilities.name: Sörmlandstrafiken skärgårdstrafik
facilities.description: Demand-responsive archipelago boat service can depart Källviks brygga or Studsvik brygga. Book by 15:30 the day before; Monday trips by Friday 15:30. If no booking exists, no trip runs, and weather/skipper can affect service.

facilities.name: Sävö gård drinking water
facilities.description: Across the water on Sävö, local sources describe a drinking-water tap at Sävö gård/fence. Approximate marker and only useful after boat transfer.

facilities.name: Sävö dry toilets
facilities.description: Across the water on Sävö, official/OSM sources describe multiple dry toilets around the island, including Lägerplatsen/Boholmsviken/west-side contexts. Show as onward-island services only.

facilities.name: Sävö open shelter / Lägerplatsen context
facilities.description: Across the water on Sävö, an open shelter/fireplace/toilet/tenting context exists near the Sävö loop. Show as onward-island context only, not a Stage 53:1 mainland facility.

facilities.name: Sävö Vandrarhem & Café
facilities.description: Seasonal island hostel/cafe service after boat transfer. 2026 cafe hours vary by season; verify before relying on food, water, or lodging.

facilities.name: Sävö stage 53:2 connection
facilities.description: Optional onward Sävö loop/stage 53:2 after boat transfer. Show only as an onward branch option from Källviks brygga/Sävö logistics.

facilities.name: Källvik complementary taxi area
facilities.description: Sörmlandstrafiken complementary traffic includes Källvik/Bromdal/Luckebol/Tofsö/Örboholm area, but must be booked by phone by 16:00 on the weekday before travel. Verify eligibility and timetable.

facilities.name: Studsvik bus access
facilities.description: Closest researched mapped bus stop to the Sandvik/Källvik corridor, but still distant from both ends. Treat as off-route access and verify live Sörmlandstrafiken routing.

facilities.name: Vagnhärad station train access
facilities.description: Remote rail access for taxi/bus planning, roughly 17-19 km direct-line from this branch. Show as regional access, not nearby trail transport.

facilities.name: Current fire-ban check
facilities.description: No municipal fire ban was found during one 2026-04-27 check, but Länsstyrelsen/SMHI showed forest-fire-risk context. Check same-day fire-ban status before using any prepared fireplace.

facilities.name: Nynäs/Sävö reserve camping and fire rules
facilities.description: Nynäs reserve limits camping and fires to designated/managed places. Luckebol reserve is side context with no public parking. On Sävö, dogs must be leashed, fires only at signed prepared fireplaces, tenting is limited by reserve rules, and fenced/designated tent places are recommended because grazing animals roam.
